Video Title: Sustainable Natural Farming System
Transcription: Sustainable Natural Farming System. What is PQNK? PQNK is the abbreviation of Paedar Qudratti Nizam Kashatkqari  ( to be pronounced as picinic) Which means sustainable nutral farming system in URdu and it is also referred to as to as paradoxical Agriculture. Asif Sharif has conceptualised PQNK through first-hand experience on his own land in the indo-gangetic plains of pakistan. He later founded pedevar, a company that works with thousands of farmers to disseminate the PQNK system and develop approprate mexhanisation. Initially, after idenfifying  that inundation, soil disturbance, and bare land are contrary to the natural processes of soil fertility and vegetation, Mr Asif developed the raised bed planting system. Rice was the first crop tested on Asif's raised beds as conventionally it is grown under flooded conditions.
